description.title: דמי השתתפות עצמית
description.summary: This table details the deductible amounts for a car insurance policy. It specifies the maximum deductible amounts for non-pecuniary damages and loss of earnings.
description.embed_passage: פוליסת חובה קובעת את גובה ההשתתפות העצמית במקרה של נזק. סכום ההשתתפות העצמית עשוי להגיע עד 25,000 ש״ח עבור נזקים שאינם ממוניים ועד 7 ימי עבודה עבור אובדן הכנסות. גובה ההשתתפות העצמית מחושב בהתאם לסוג הנזק.
description.row_axis: Types of damages covered by the policy
notable_values: Maximum loss of earnings deductible: 7 ימי עבודה

sketch:
4. Deductible
4.1 The insurer shall be entitled to set-off a deductible in regard to the driver whose name appears on the insurance certificate, upon the fulfillment of all the conditions for compliance with the stipulation regarding a deductible in accordance with the Motor Vehicle Insurance Regulations (deductible) (temporary provision) 5768-2008, including when the policy owner selects a policy which includes a stipulation in regard to a deductible, a choice which is documented by the insurer and the insurance certificate notes that the policy includes a deductible stipulation in accordance with the aforementioned regulations.
4.2 The deductible which the insurer may set-off from the insurance benefits upon the occurrence of an insured event which is covered by this policy, upon fulfillment of the conditions appearing in sub-paragraph 4.1 - shall be calculated in accordance with the type of damage caused and shall not exceed NIS 25,000 in regard to non-pecuniary damages and 7 working days in regard to loss of earnings.

4.2 The deductible which the insurer may set-off from the insurance benefits upon the occurrence of an insured event which is covered by this policy, upon fulfillment of the conditions appearing in sub-paragraph 4.1 - shall be calculated in accordance with the type of damage caused and shall not exceed NIS 25,000 in regard to non-pecuniary damages and 7 working days in regard to loss of earnings.
